systems.system: RPPCUB-2026 (Recensement des propriétaires des propriétés ou parcelles dans les centres urbains du Burundi)
systems.owner: Government of Burundi; technical presentation by INSBU
systems.tiers: first phase: communes of Muha, Mukaza and Ntahangwa and the towns of Gitega, Ngozi and Rumonge; digitised geo-referenced land register with a Web GIS, launched 14 July 2026

note: A land register census, out of scope; nothing on civil registration.
